decision: GO FOR THE REVIEWED PINNED RESUME OF THE RETAINED PRE-START REFUSAL
execution: Exact Python test files invoked directly; unittest discovery does not collect these hyphenated filenames and its zero-test result was not counted.
reviewedInvariants: Only the same recorded original-account pre-start refusal is resumable; any prior new-source start, missing/wrong phase, partial account/service path or changed source is rejected.
Original protected package/index/helpers and compiled runtime remain unchanged; fresh repair code is verified and executed in memory.
The repair execution namespace must contain the SHA computed from the same hash-verified body as __poe_verified_driver_sha256__.
Old verified before-stop backup, prior phase receipts and all current ledger history survive; retry backup uses a fresh numbered directory.
Current financial identity and flat unchanged obligations plus exact old whole-column journal/action prefix are verified before another stop.
Financial owner lease remains held during complete stable stop metadata, MainPID/ControlPID zero, no job and empty or removed fixed service cgroup checks.
A terminal failed unit is not certified graceful. Fresh same-inode financial audit and a newly verified stopped backup remain mandatory.
Post-start financial source is retained on verification failure; original ledger is never initialized, imported, reseeded or restored.
limitations: Actual first-attempt state remains unknown; this change does not retroactively classify that failure.
No host operation, real service stop, original ledger access, staging or owner-command execution by this review.
Fresh live stop/cutover, original account/history preservation and reporting acceptance must be verified after owner execution.
